routes.claim: V, W and the Chebyshev tensors T_i(tau V), T_j(tau W) depend only on (patch, panel). They contain no drift e, no function r and no candidate coefficient, so they are identical across all 322 sub-cells and all 19 functions and may be computed once per (patch, panel).
routes.exactness: exact reuse of identical quantities; no bound is weakened

routes.claim: the per-panel work is dominated by Python-level scalar arb dispatch; restructuring the contractions to bulk index order reduces dispatch count without changing any value
routes.exactness: identical arithmetic, reordered; interval semantics unchanged

routes.claim: the panel operator M[i][j][a][b] = sum_{k1,k2} P[i][a][k1] Q[j][b][k2] N_{k1+k2} is candidate-independent and depends on e only through the Gaussian moments N. Build it once per (patch, panel, e) and contract with each of the 19 candidates. Factorises via R[i][a][k2] = sum_k1 P[i][a][k1] N_{k1+k2}, turning a rank-4 build into two cheap contractions.
routes.exactness: exact algebraic refactoring of the same sum; identical enclosures

routes.reason: the baseline already skips zero coefficients via is_zero() guards, and the only structural sparsity is at the softplus source (c[a][k] nonzero for a+k <= 9), which the Chebyshev composition fills in by degree 2. There is no further provably-zero structure to exploit without a tail bound, and introducing a negligibility threshold would change certificate semantics. Rejected on mathematical grounds BEFORE benchmarking, as required.

benchmark_cells.rationale: the exact Task1R reference cell; the only cell with a qualified certificate
maximal z-span over the 64x64 grid, hence the maximal panel count; the geometrically hardest cell for the panel loop. Selected by argmax over frozen geometry, before any timing.
maximises phi(U_c+e)+phi(L_c+e), the Gaussian weight at the two x-dependent integration endpoints, hence the largest endpoint-sliver term. Selected by argmax over frozen geometry, before any timing.
a second candidate on the reference geometry, to establish that the per-function cost is candidate-independent and that reuse claims are not an artifact of one candidate. Non-decisive; closed form.
generic-regression control: the CUSUM backend is untouched by this audit, so its timing must not move.

audit_cap_rationale: a micro-benchmark campaign; 0.5 CPU-h is 1/10 of the suggested ceiling and 0.027% of the historical K1 cap. No extension after T2O.
